services.desc: 20 Full RV hook-ups (water, sewer, electricity). Services available approximately the end of April to the end of October. Showers are available at the Peter Fidler Park Campground. Travel north on Centre Street. How to Pay All fees are due in advance. The preferred method of payment is by Interact e-Transfer to payments@villageofempress.ca. Be sure to put in the message/memo section what the payment is for. See Bill Payments. For payments by credit card or cash, please visit either the Empress Village Office or That’s Empressive.
